detail.title: Detail

lawful_basis_ref.description: What was checked (§30 purpose limitation). None if the refusal reason is 'lawful_basis_absent' (nothing to check).

reason_code.title: Reason Code

refused_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of refusal decision.
refused_at.title: Refused At

substrate_contract_ref.description: What was resolved against for rights (§29.1). None if refusal reason is 'lawful_basis_absent'.
